title: docs(investigations): March 2026 consolidation recovery census (evidence only)
intent: Census what the March 15-21 consolidation period stranded: compare every March output bundle to Git by content hash, check 'complete / integrated' claims for reachability, and record dispositions in a ledger. Split out of #439 so it can be reviewed as a standalone forensic dataset. Evidence only; no production behaviour changes.
behavior_change: None. No file under services/api/app, packages/client, workflows, configs or baselines is modified. Adds the census directory, four read-only evidence tools under scripts/investigations/, one census test module, and one ACKNOWLEDGED_NON_DIMENSION_FILES entry in test_jumbo_dimension_consistency.py (BUNDLE_CENSUS.json mentions jumbo only in member filenames; its hits on the canonical body magnitudes are hex digests and a byte size). Findings: 52 sources, 194 candidates, one safety candidate (/api/headstock/transition/gcode) recorded and routed to HEADSTOCK-TRANSITION-GCODE-SAFETY-001; #441 has since contained the route (409 before generation); the generator is not fixed here or there.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Census dataset (raw census JSON, members, derived ledger/inventory/planning CSVs, claim inputs and reachability results), methodology and findings documents, a reviewer map and per-row proof classes (MECHANICALLY_VERIFIED / HEURISTIC_CANDIDATE / MANUALLY_ADJUDICATED / SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE / UNRESOLVED), OVERRIDE_REVIEW.md covering every manual ruling with a reviewer column, an independent spot-check (SPOT_CHECK.md) with a negative control, a regeneration map, linguist-generated marking for machine outputs, four evidence tools, and 10 integrity and fixture tests.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: No prior census compared the March bundles to Git by content hash or checked 'complete' claims for reachability. The CL-RED premise is corrected by erratum rather than built on.

commands_run: python -I scripts/investigations/march_2026_bundle_census.py over 52 sources (ZIPs read in memory; bundles outside Git)
python -I scripts/investigations/march_2026_claim_reachability.py --root <git archive d42712e0>: byte-identical to the committed MARCH_CLAIM_REACHABILITY.csv
python -I scripts/investigations/march_2026_census_ledger.py: ledger, inventory and planning regenerate byte-for-byte
python -I scripts/investigations/march_2026_census_spot_check.py over the 52 located bundles: 44 rows, 84 checks PASS, 0 FAIL; negative control (tampered row) exits 1
Mutation checks: reverting the HISTORY_ONLY rule, a wrong review row, and removing the duplicate-key check each fail at least one census test
